verdict.rationale: Visual scripting is a fair axis for a game engine, but the evidence shows PlayCanvas gameplay logic is written as code: 'Scripts are the heart of interactivity', implemented as ESM class-syntax scripts. The Editor's 'visual tools over code' refers to drag-and-drop scene building, an adjacent feature, not node-based or visual gameplay-logic authoring.

support.subject: As a technical artist, I can build gameplay logic with visual scripting without writing code
